text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prisoners at Oshakati alleged they were tortured by police and laid 25 charges against members of the criminal investigation divisions at Oshakati, Ombalantu and Omungwelume.
- Jobless ex-combatants said they would stay at the Windhoek showgrounds as part of a protest to demand employment.

- Namibia Breweries Ltd (NamBrew) accused South African Breweries of unfair trade practices in the introduction of SAB's non-returnable 750 ml bottle in Namibia. Apart from the label, the bottle is almost identical to the local brewer's returnable bottle, but made of thinner glass.
- Well-known helicopter pilot Pieter Stassen was killed while trying to lift the wreckage of a light plane which crashed near Impalila island in the Caprivi on Monday.
- Tariffs for bulk water supplied from all national water schemes are to be increased by 20 percent from September 1.
